cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Stay for the Hard Part
cards.instruction: Create increasing moments of emotional honesty to test whether someone remains present and supportive.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I wasn't just late to the reunion. Remember when I coached your interviews? Let me finish an answer before you help me with it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I saved you a seat. Was it the traffic?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: There's that helpful answer. No. I waited outside for half an hour. Can you stay for the less sensible bit?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm here. I thought you didn't want to sit with me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I did. I thought you'd enjoy yourself more if I stayed outside. Don't tidy that up for me. Just sit beside me now, if you still want to.

reason: Name the earlier coaching situation that makes A use interview-answer corrections while seeking support for a personal admission.
